traps: It is a lecture: there are no decisions and no action items. 'Next week we cover wastewater treatment and reuse' (line 43) is the course plan, not a task.
Self-correction (line 24): the lecturer says about 50 bar, then corrects it to 55-80 bar depending on salinity. 50 bar is wrong.
Not a decision (line 42): a possible visit to a desalination plant at the end of the term, explicitly not confirmed.
A date that is not a deadline (line 34): 'in the eighties' energy use was about double; it is history.
The student's question (line 44) is in the same empty speaker column; the lecturer defers the answer to next week (line 45), so it stays an open question.
